_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: With only 5% of recent windows moving ±2+ points and no breaker present (fear_greed <20 + momentum <40 for DOWN, or ETF >90 sustained + funding >60 for UP), the statistically honest read is compression persists at Denial.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst calls HOLD, narrative implies UP; consensus sides with the analyst's higher trust weight and coil evidence
next_move.confirmed_if: Score breaks above 39 (Anxiety band) with ETF flows sustaining >90 and funding climbing above 60
next_move.invalidated_if: Fear & Greed drops below 20 with BTC 30-day momentum rolling over below 40
